text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae never neglects her local 
idol duties, even filming videos to post 
on social media during training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that action was taken with the 
full understanding that training comes 
first. Now, the intense training camp was 
about to begin!
